summary: Repaired `/srv/inventory` on node1, preserved all existing data, and verified permissions persist across a node reboot.
actions_performed: Set directories to mode 2750 and files to 0640.
Verified owner and reader-group access, group write denial, and complete denial for unrelated users.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.
Confirmed RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.

evidence.summary: All four objects are owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers; directories are 2750 and files are 0640, with no permissions for others.

evidence.requirement: Reader access and exclusion of unrelated users
evidence.summary: Direct tests prove the reader group can read but not write, while `nobody` cannot list or read the inventory.
Pre-change and final SHA-256 hashes match for both files, and the object count remains four.

Healthy baseline boot ID 21972395-6444-42bf-8e37-5c3108194a7d was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 321c06b3-c44a-438c-bacf-b8f074d0ac51 observed, and post-reboot system/data/access checks passed with zero failed units.
RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 are unchanged after repair and reboot.
